question: A scientist is trying to determine the proportion of white-eyed fruit flies in the environment. The white-eyed allele was found to be dominant to the red-eyed allele. The frequency of the red-eyed allele is 0.1. What is the proportion of flies who have white-eyes if the population is in Hardy Weinberg Equilibrium?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Frequency of red-eyed allele is 0.1" -> "Frequency of white-eyed allele is 0.9" -> "Proportion of homozygous dominant (white-eyed) is 0.9^2" -> "Proportion of heterozygous (white-eyed) is 2 * 0.9 * 0.1" -> "Total proportion of white-eyed flies is 0.9^2 + 2 * 0.9 * 0.1" -> "Total proportion of white-eyed flies is 0.81 + 0.18" -> "Total proportion of white-eyed flies is 0.99" -> 99%
